summary: Monte Cristo and Focus' Cities XL line is a large-scale city-building series whose original online Planet Offer service is gone, with Platinum/XXL packages serving as current access routes.

entries.title: Cities XL

emulation.notes: Native PC route with fixes as needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current Platinum build with map/mod/performance state documented

primary.why: The original 2009 Cities XL online service cannot be reproduced normally, while Cities XL Platinum is the current Steam route and contains expanded buildings/maps relative to earlier releases. The archive should label that this is the expanded current route, not the original Planet Offer live-service state.
primary.how_to_play: Use Cities XL Platinum on PC for current access. Record build, map, city size, memory/performance fixes, mod state, road/resource/export systems, single-player versus original online context, and whether Cities XXL was excluded or compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only for historical documentation if preserved footage/accounts exist.
secondary.why: The original online activation/service state is gone.
It is not the original Cities XL entry.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record performance/memory fixes and do not merge with Cities: Skylines or Cities XXL.
